verdict.justification: The project aims to create an educational game for teaching English to engineering students at Universidad del Valle sede Tuluá. The goal is to enhance the interactive offerings of the global EnglishPlay project, which aims to increase motivation for learning English by providing interactive tools. The project uses video games as an interactive tool for English language learning, allowing students to learn while playing and having fun. An evaluation heuristic template was also implemented to test the playability and usability of the game.
